title: The forgotten backup
brief: A developer left their login on the wiki. Staging may hold old backups with secrets in them.
hint.1: The note in your home folder has a login. Use ssh dev@staging and type the password when asked.
hint.3: The api_key value looks like Base64. base64 -d <text> decodes it.
walkthrough: cat notes.txt, ssh dev@staging, cd /var/backups, cat config.bak, base64 -d <the key>, submit.
debrief: Base64 is an encoding, not encryption: anyone can reverse it with no key. Secrets in old backups and wikis are a classic leak. Defenders: keep secrets out of backups, rotate keys and use a secrets manager.
objective.login: Log in to staging over ssh
objective.flag: Decode the key and submit the flag
